title: IQ Go Bye Bye
description:
Hello, my little idiots!
It’s time for yet anotherBye Byefile! It’s a sort of spiritual successor toBrain Go Bye Bye, but completely self-contained and done in a much different and more direct way. Without spoiling too much, I delve deeply into your mind and find the parts responsible for your intellect…and then crack them open, leaving you feeling dumber and dumber and dumber as the session progresses. Even though it’s tagged as a “curse,” it’s only temporary in nature without direct reinforcement from another party. There are more spoilers if you continue reading, but first…
There are three different version of this file, each with a different induction:
IQGBB – Rapid Induction:If you’re already conditioned to my voice or to drop triggers, this is the version you want. It starts with a 4-minute rapid induction that was created specifically for this file.
IQGBB –Long Bye Bye Induction:This is a version with the original induction (relaxed, deep, blank, hypnotic trance) from the very first Brain Go Bye Bye file. It’s somewhat dated, but still works perfectly.
IQBGG –Kinky Induction:Another full induction, originally from my Kinky Workout file. It’s very, very effective and focuses on the power of my voice bringing you down, down, down into that beautiful hypnotic abyss.
You can always read the script for full spoilers, but here are the spark-notes:
Now go listen, idiots.
